weighting.basis: EQUAL across views (D24). Every view covers every Gram Panchayat in the drop by construction, so population coverage cannot distinguish them; `reach` is the distinct Gram Panchayats each view holds rows for, measured, and it is the same for all three
weighting.formula: global_score = view_weight x within_view_score x 0.85^(view_rank - 1); each view's best finding is seeded unconditionally
weighting.redundancy: fill-stage marginal gain = global_score - min(global_score, worst), worst = max over the selected set of min(item, selected) x r; r is gated on shared measure / breakdown / non-trivial subspace lineage
